description: Search recent French public-procurement notices in the official DILA BOAMP open dataset. Keyword in notice title; returns bounded, sourced records with publication and deadline. Free beta, not exhaustive, no private data or scraped websites.

days_back.description: How far back to search; default 30 days.

keyword.description: Short French tender keyword e.g. granulés, maintenance, travaux. No user-controlled SQL or URLs.

strict_match.description: Default true: after official fuzzy search, require normalized literal keyword in notice subject to reduce false positives.

name: search_public_tenders
